candidate.version_description: Since there isn't a traditional verse-chorus form in this song, and instead mainly a large jam section combined with some spare vocals, I made the section dividers as such: 'Intro' for the piano part at the beginning, 'Verse' for the bit of vocals, and 'Whispered' for at the end, after the band stops playing. Original audio taken from here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8y1ROzCUpbU.
